goal: Clone the useMtr/useLastMtr react-query hooks for the formato4 lifecycle (create/execute/cancel/list/get + last-completion) plus the api.ts functions they call.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: src/lib/api.ts exposes getFormato4Runs, getFormato4Run, createFormato4Run, executeFormato4, cancelFormato4 hitting /formato4/runs* (mirroring the MTR fns), and getLastFormato4 hitting /metadata/last-formato4 with the periodParams behaviour.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest src/__tests__/api-formato4.test.ts (mirrors api-last-period pattern) asserts each fn calls api with the correct path/method/params

acceptance_criteria.criterion: src/modules/formato4/hooks/useFormato4.ts exports useFormato4Runs, useFormato4Run, useCreateFormato4Run, useExecuteFormato4, useCancelFormato4. useFormato4Runs polls every 3000ms while any run status is in [pending,running] and stops (refetchInterval false) when terminal; useFormato4Run polls 3000ms while its run is pending/running.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest renderHook tests: list returns items, mutations call the right api fn and invalidate; refetchInterval logic returns 3000 vs false for active vs terminal data

acceptance_criteria.criterion: src/modules/formato4/hooks/useLastFormato4.ts exports useLastFormato4 returning the countries map from getLastFormato4.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest renderHook test asserts it resolves to the countries map

acceptance_criteria.criterion: mock-server serves GET /metadata/last-formato4 (and mock-api.ts has the matching fallback) so the hook is not dead against the mock.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: grep mock-server/server.js and src/lib/mock-api.ts for last-formato4

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Repo stays green: tsc -b clean, eslint clean, full vitest suite passes with the new tests.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npx tsc -b && npx eslint . && npx vitest run
